author: Nerdstalgic
description:
When Shoresy was first announced, almost nobody believed it would work. Taking a faceless, one note joke character from Letterkenny and giving him his own series sounded like the definition of a cash grab. But against all expectations, Jared Keeso turned Shoresy into one of the funniest, and most heartfelt comedy spin-offs in recent memory.

The secret wasn't simply giving Shoresy more screen time, it was completely reinventing how the character and the series worked. By adding genuine character growth, emotional stakes, and a supporting cast that could stand alongside him, Shoresy became more than a continuation of Letterkenny. For many fans, it became the better show.

title: How Letterkenny Turned A Joke Into A Successful TV Show
